messages.subject: Introduction and Data Mining
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm relatively new to the R world, and thought I would send a quick
introduction. After spending some time in the "real" world as an
engineer, I have returned to university life and have started towards
a master's degree in computer science. My research currently involves
data mining in an agricultural setting, and the tools include GRASS
and R.

I'm trying to decide if I've come up the learning curve far enough to
contribute new code for R as part of GSoC. I must decide soon, the
deadline for student applications is approaching fast :)

I've seen the list of project ideas, interactive animations look
interesting, so I will email the mentors there directly. If there are
other ideas I should consider that haven't made the suggestions list
relating to data mining I'm happy to discuss them as well.

Regards,
Eric
